text:
maria_ops: heads-up — eu-west-1 gpu-spot nodegroup (gpu-spot-eu1) seeing a sudden spike in spot preemptions, ~60% of nodes terminated in last 8m :rotating_light:
infra-bot: [alert] Instance termination events detected for nodepool gpu-spot-eu1 (10 -> 4 nodes). Autoscaler events logged.
alex_infra: seeing a backlog of Pending GPU pods in namespace inference - almost all are Backoff/Unschedulable. `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending`
samira_sre: autoscaler log: "no nodes available that match pods' constraints" + thrashing between provisioning spot and failing allocation. repeating scale up -> terminate loop.
maria_ops: confirmed. Cluster-autoscaler repeatedly requests new spot VMs, cloud returns preempted and we hit API rate limits.
jonah_platform: region quota for on-demand GPUs is low; we've been relying on spot pool for burst. quota shows 0/10 on-demand GPUs left.
alex_infra: plan: 1) taint gpu-spot-eu1 as NoSchedule (prevent new pods landing on unstable nodes) 2) scale up gpu-on-demand-eu by +3 (if quota allows) 3) move low-priority batch jobs to a different queue.
samira_sre: running `kubectl taint nodes -l cloud.google.com/nodepool=gpu-spot-eu1 spot.unstable=true:NoSchedule` to stop new scheduling. will cordon abused nodes.
alex_infra: doing manual request to cloud quota team for emergency bump +5 on-demand GPUs, but that will take ~20-30m (ticket  INC-8793).
maria_ops: while quota is pending, evict non-critical pods from pending queue and bind to ephemeral workstation pool where possible. adding PDB relax for batch-inference.
jonah_platform: applying quick fix: `kubectl patch deployment batch-inference -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"temp-sched":"allow-evict"}}}}}'`
infra-bot: autoscaler: "ScaleUp: launching 3 instances in gpu-on-demand-eu" (attempt) — note: 1 of 3 failed due to zone capacity.
samira_sre: evictions started for lowest priority pods in inference; moved ~12 pods to warm standby on cpu-backed fallback nodes (reduced perf but keeps services alive).
alex_infra: also disabled a heavy cronjob that was filling GPUs every 5m: `kubectl scale cronjob heavy-batch -n infra --replicas=0`
maria_ops: monitoring token: token-level dashboards show 3% latency spike and cost delta ramping. cost alert queued.
jonah_platform: added autoscaler config change: increase `expander: least-waste` and bump `max-node-provision-time` to 15m to avoid scale down mid-provision. patch applied.
samira_sre: observed one runaway job with no resources.limits set — killed that pod, adding admission webhook rule to block missing GPU limits on future jobs.
alex_infra: summary: tainted spot pool, cordoned most unstable nodes, requested on-demand quota, scaled down noncritical work, adjusted autoscaler heuristics. still watching for re-surge.
maria_ops: current metrics: pending GPU pods 18 -> 4 over last 12m, autoscaler events stabilizing. keep channel for updates, will escalate to on-call infra lead if unresolved in 30m. :thumbsup:
